_definition: Curated list of Europe-micro companies in current financial distress / insolvency proceedings (same definition as the Europe file). Informational only.

ENXTPA:BIG.summary: Accelerated safeguard (sauvegarde acceleree) proceeding opened by Lille Metropole commercial court judgment of 17 Aug 2026; extended on 7 Oct 2026 to ~9-17 Dec 2026 (sources differ); restructuring to complete by end Q1 2027. Shares were temporarily suspended 20 Feb 2026 and resumed 4 Mar 2026; still quoted in Aug 2026 (AbcBourse 14 Aug 2026). Current trading status after Aug 2026 not confirmed.
